summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of full redemption of its Series 114 1.722% Senior Non Preferred Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Notes due 2027. The issuer will redeem all $1.5 billion outstanding principal on September 14, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest, as permitted under the indenture. This is a routine debt redemption under a call option and does not constitute an equity special situation such as a tender offer, capital return, or restructuring. No board recommendation, advisors, or unusual terms are mentioned; it is a contractual debt management action.
